answer: Anchored heartbeat ledger gates each token behind 72 hours of signed RF beacons from one GPS point, making the dwell horizon the entry cost. Any location jump over 1.2 km or gap over 6 s voids the token and broadcasts a saffron flag to all mesh validators. Per identity, an attacker must hold one physical site with uninterrupted power for 72 hours; dual-site relays trigger ember revocation.
